data.content_ref: inline:The problem requires connecting 0e26d6be54fd to its neighbourhood by proposing a substantive relation to neighbouring artifacts. SRC_002 instead reduces the *isolation* itself to a token-economy constraint (SRC_001), explicitly stating "isolation is an economic phenomenon, not an epistemological one." By framing the relation as a reduction to a resource budget, it bypasses the neighbourhood entirely and fails to establish any substantive epistemological or mechanistic relation between 0e26d6be54fd and its neighbouring artifacts, which is the core demand of the problem.
